I could not verify this from first principles, so the answer below is from recall of the literature rather than a derivation.

The problem is based on a published structural classification of 4-vertex-critical {P₇, C₃}-free graphs. As I recall it, that classification shows that the graphs containing an induced C₇ form a finite family of 12 pairwise non-isomorphic graphs. I have not checked the list itself, and I did not run a computer search to confirm the count.

ANSWER: 12
